**DO NOT open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Please report security vulnerabilities through one of these private channels:

1. **Preferred**: [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/craton-co/craton-shield-enterprise/security/advisories/new)
2. **Alternative**: Email [security@craton.com.ar](mailto:security@craton.com.ar) with subject `[CRATON SHIELD SECURITY] <brief description>`

See [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for full details on our vulnerability reporting process, scope, and response timeline.

You will receive an acknowledgment within 48 hours. We will work with you to understand and address the issue before public disclosure.
